Setup.title: Getting started
Setup.subtitle: Set up your development environment for local autotest development
Setup.step1_desc: Download and install the latest LTS version of Node.js from the official website. This is the runtime for your tests.
Setup.step2_desc: The best editor for test development. Has excellent TypeScript and Playwright support.
Setup.step3_desc: Install the 'Playwright Test for VS Code' extension from the marketplace. This enables one-click test runs.
Setup.step4_desc: Run this command in your terminal: npm init playwright@latest. This creates the project structure and installs browsers.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.q1: Will this course work for me if I have no programming experience?
FAQ.a1: Yes! We start from the basics. We also provide detailed documentation and support at every stage.
FAQ.q2: How is this different from YouTube videos?
FAQ.a2: The main difference is practice. You don't just watch — you write code in the browser, get instant verification and feedback.
FAQ.q3: What technologies are covered in the course?
FAQ.a3: We focus on Playwright and TypeScript — the most modern stack for test automation.
FAQ.q4: Will I get a certificate after completion?
FAQ.a4: Yes, after completing all practical tasks you will receive a personal certificate of course completion.
FAQ.q5: How long does the course take?
FAQ.a5: The course is designed to be completed at your own pace. On average it takes 4 to 8 weeks.
FAQ.q6: Do I need special software for the course?
FAQ.a6: No, everything you need to write and run tests is already built into our online platform.
FAQ.q7: Is there support during the course?
FAQ.a7: Of course! You can ask questions in our private community or contact support.
FAQ.q8: Is this course good for interview preparation?
FAQ.a8: Yes, we cover real cases and architectural approaches (e.g., Page Object Model) that are frequently asked in technical interviews.
